title: Tree
description: Fiori tree: nested items with expand/collapse (→ / ←), indentation levels and the List selection modes.

usage.summary: Browse or select hierarchical items through expandable parent-child nodes.
useWhen: Expose a meaningful nested hierarchy that users need to expand and collapse.
Allow one or several node selections with selectionMode="single" or "multiple".
Handle expansion with onItemToggle; control a TreeItem with expanded and onExpandedChange when the application owns its state.

avoidWhen.when: Present flat items or a collection with only group headers and one item level.
Choose one value from a short nonhierarchical list.
Compare attributes of flat records in columns.
